description: This Java source file defines the class DittoTrustManager, which implements custom SSL trust management for verifying server certificates and hostnames in a secure communication setup. It handles different trust verification scenarios, logs exceptions, and includes private helper methods for hostname/IP normalization.

classes.name: DittoTrustManager
classes.description: A custom X509TrustManager that performs certificate and hostname verification, with special handling for revocation checks and IPv6 address normalization.

methods.name: wrapTrustManagers
methods.description: Creates and returns an array containing a single DittoTrustManager instance wrapping provided trust managers with revocation check settings, hostname/IP, and logging.

methods.name: checkClientTrusted
methods.description: Delegates client trust verification to the underlying delegate trust manager with revocation check.

methods.name: checkServerTrusted
methods.description: Performs server certificate trust verification, including chain validation and hostname verification, with error logging.

methods.name: getAcceptedIssuers
methods.description: Returns the list of accepted issuing certificates, delegated from the underlying trust manager.
